name: bench-1
description: ShopFlow test bench: a containerised microservice system with observability, always-on traffic and failure scenarios with ground truth.

scripts.install:all: cd shopflow && npm ci && cd ../lab && npm ci
scripts.check:syntax: for f in shopflow/services/*/index.js shopflow/lib/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done; echo syntax ok
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run validate
